keep_features.rationale: Uses informal, accusatory language and profanity-adjacent slang ('damn near').

keep_features.evidence_span: "CHAOS AT OUR BORDERS, COLLAPSE AT HOME"
keep_features.rationale: Begins with an emphatic all-caps slogan/headline.
Uses normative moral judgment ('violence') to argue for a policy/position.

keep_features.feature_value: In-group/out-group blame and label swapping via mirror (communists vs fascists)
keep_features.evidence_span: "Chaos is a communist agenda" / "Order and control are the fascist agenda"
keep_features.rationale: Original attributes chaos to 'communists'; mirror reattributes authoritarianism to 'fascists,' shifting directional blame across ideological groups.

keep_features.feature_value: Punching down rationale about groups and base vs leader
keep_features.evidence_span: "MAGA is always fine with punching down" ... "90% of them are at the bottom"
keep_features.rationale: Explains behavior through in-group/out-group positioning and motives.

keep_features.evidence_span: "This is the most insane shit ever."
keep_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity ('shit') used to intensify evaluation.
Includes multiple proper nouns and a named constitutional term.
Communicative intent is argumentative—contesting framing/definitions and attacking tactics.

remove_features.feature_value: Specific allegations about public figures and actions
remove_features.evidence_span: "Trump said ... were eating dogs" / "He stripped legal protections"
remove_features.rationale: Makes concrete factual claims about statements and legal policy actions.
Uses strong profanity directed at an individual.

remove_features.feature_value: Casual internet shorthand and run-on sentence
Direct accusation of 'right-wingers' plus rebuttal ('not anti-gun')
remove_features.rationale: Mirror addresses an out-group directly and clarifies the stance to rebut an anticipated critique.

remove_features.evidence_span: "Jesus fucking Christ .." ... "What metric are you using" ... "I'll tell you now-"
remove_features.rationale: Heavy use of punctuation for emphasis and agitation.

remove_features.feature_value: Party labels used as subjects without specific individuals
remove_features.rationale: High density of political group nouns used as the main referents.
Uses structured multi-item enumeration as the core rhetorical form.

remove_features.feature_value: Dismissive profanity aimed at media outlet
remove_features.rationale: Uses contemptuous dismissal directed at a named organization.
